meta.name: browserstack
meta.description: Run tests on BrowserStack. Use when user mentions "browserstack", "cross-browser", "cloud testing", "browser matrix", "test on safari", "test on firefox", or "browser compatibility".

copy.tagline: 在真实浏览器上运行跨浏览器测试
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多种浏览器和设备上验证网页表现
copy.tagline_en: Run cross-browser tests on real devices
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to verify web app behavior across multiple browsers and devices

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能帮你配置 Playwright 测试项目，在 BrowserStack 云端运行跨浏览器测试，并查看测试结果、视频和日志。
howto.when: 当你提到“browserstack”、“跨浏览器测试”、“云测试”等关键词，或要求测试 Safari、Firefox 等浏览器时触发。

say.text: 查看最近一次 BrowserStack 构建的结果。
say.note: Claude 会获取并展示测试状态。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can configure your Playwright project to run cross-browser tests on BrowserStack's cloud grid, and retrieve test results, videos, and logs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "browserstack", "cross-browser", "cloud testing", or ask to test on Safari, Firefox, etc.

say_en.text: Run my tests on BrowserStack with Chrome and Firefox.
say_en.note: Claude will configure and execute the tests.

say_en.text: Show me the latest BrowserStack build results.
say_en.note: Claude will fetch and display test statuses.
